title: Event on event collision detection. Easy fix?

posts.author: Lomaxient
posts.body:
So in my snowboarding mini-game there will dozens of obstacles and a set of pursuers (it's a dramatic escape scene). The movement is an illusion created by a scrolling parallax and many obstacles. The pursuers simply move from left to right (I think). Each time the player collides with an object he jumps back(upwards) two tiles. If he hits too many obstacles the pursuers will catch him.
The player works just fine, but the pursuers are troubling, because making a an event collide with another event seems really long winded. In the methods I've found so far the pursuer's need a region location and the obstacle needs a region location stored in a pair of variables to trigger the collision event. e.g. if pursuer's x & y coordinates match an obstacle's x & y coordinates then yeet the pursuer.
This would mean creating new variables for every event and every pursuer. That would be bonkers!
I saw a plugin that looks like it would make the process easy, but it was built for MV. (I'm using MZ). I'll post that in a spoiler below.
You guys have been killing it recently, just need to get this over the finish line. Thanks as always.
Show me the juicy plugin! Maybe there's something in the VisuStellar Cores I've missed?
Spoiler:
RMMV Plugin
http://sumrndm.site/collision-checker/

Have a lovely day. For now I shall ask the mods to close this thread as it seem the issue is resolved.
For others that might read this thread.
The solution to automatic event on event collision in RMMZ requires two plugins.
1. Download
FOSSIL
and put it at the top of your plugin list. (I haven't tested for conflicts)
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...-plugins-in-mz-300-plugins-fossilized.135523/
2. Download the
SRD Collision Checker
and use the commands listed on his page in a conditional branch to manage the outcome of a collision.
http://sumrndm.site/collision-checker/
Obviously you need to put the JS files into your RPG Maker plugin directory.
